skill.summary: Scan nearby BLE MAC addresses to mint unique soulbound $ANIMA tokens stored locally using hash and DAG-based proof-of-remnant logic.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of BLE-Anima-Minter.

- Scans for nearby BLE MAC addresses.
- Hashes MAC addresses with SHA256 and salt.
- Mints soulbound `$ANIMA` tokens using AnimaChain logic.
- Stores proofs in a local DAG memory node.
- Supports optional gossip-sync with other nodes.
